question:
**Parts of the following sentence are given as options. Identify the segment that contains a grammatical error.**

During winters in Delhi, flights are oftenly cancelled due to heavy fog.
solution:
The correct answer is '**oftenly cancelled**'.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The given above sentence is grammatically incorrect.
 
• '**Often**' is not an adjective and '**oftenly**' is not an adverb.
 
• An **adverb **is a word that **modifies a sentence, verb, or adjective**.
 
• As per the general rule, "**Often**" is an adverb meaning ‘**many times on different occasions**’. 
 
• **Example:**
 
 
• *I have often wondered what happened to him. (correct)*
 
• *I have oftenly wondered what happened to him. (incorrect)*
 
 
 
• *​*Here, in the given above sentence, '**oftenly**' is used as an adverb which is wrong.
 
• According to the explanation that is given above, ‘often’ is the correct use in place of “oftenly”.

**Correct sentence: ***During winters in Delhi, flights are **often** cancelled due to heavy fog.*

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/51867102c7c2f369f6e29d2efe025e3b3367c68261ec20262828d84ca5c8f854.png] **Hinglish__**

__
 
• ऊपर दिया गया वाक्य व्याकरण की दृष्टि से गलत है।
 
• '**Often**' एक विशेषण नहीं है और '**oftenly**' एक क्रिया विशेषण नहीं है।
 
• क्रिया विशेषण एक ऐसा शब्द है जो किसी वाक्य, क्रिया या विशेषण को संशोधित करता है।
 
• सामान्य नियम के अनुसार, "**often**" एक क्रिया विशेषण है जिसका अर्थ है **'कई बार विभिन्न अवसरों पर'**।
 
• **उदाहरण**:
 
 
• I have often wondered what happened to him. (**सही**)
 
• I have oftenly wondered what happened to him. (**गलत**)
 
 
 
• यहाँ, ऊपर दिए गए वाक्य में, '**oftenly**' का प्रयोग क्रिया विशेषण के रूप में किया जाता है जो गलत है।
 
• ऊपर दी गई व्याख्या के अनुसार, "**oftenly**" के स्थान पर '**often**' का सही प्रयोग किया जाना चाहिए।

* [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__***

__
 
• * *It's easy to assume that all **adverbs end** in '**-ly**', since so many do, **but that isn't always the case**. Here is a **list of adverbs that don’t end in '-ly'**: (यह मान लेना आसान है कि सभी क्रियाविशेषण '-ly' में समाप्त होते हैं, क्योंकि कई करते हैं, लेकिन हमेशा ऐसा नहीं होता है। यहाँ क्रियाविशेषणों की एक सूची दी गई है जो '-ly' में समाप्त नहीं होते हैं:)

 
 
• "Already, often, quick, never, hard, late, etc."
 
 
 
• **Examples: **
 
 
• *We **already **knew that he was coming to visit. (correct)*
 
• *We **alreadyly **knew that he was coming to visit. (incorrect)*
